text:
Type: plain white shelf board
Use: a wall shelf for books, plants and decor once fixed on separate brackets; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white foil-finish particleboard, smooth matte surface
Colors: white, light cream edge
Shape: flat rectangular plank with square corners and thin straight edges, plain surface, slim low profile, light visual weight
Feel: clean, simple, airy
Goes with: white walls, wooden or black metal brackets, light wood; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms
